hardware_timing_dependencies.claim: Some parts need bus reset disabled because their link does not retrain after SBR (NVIDIA GB10, ASM1164); others because the PCIe subsystem disables LTSSM on SBR (TI C667X).

evidence.excerpt: the link may not retrain correctly

external_interfaces.claim: Effect is consumed by the PCI core reset logic (pci_reset_bus / VFIO) through the per-device flag; the quirk has 14 registrations across 7 vendors.

compatibility_certification_sensitive.claim: Disabling bus reset has a security/isolation cost: for TI C667X the device state leaks between VMs. Removing the flag restores isolation but reintroduces the hang.

evidence.excerpt: With this change, the device can be assigned to VMs with VFIO, but it will leak state between VMs.

reasoning.claim: Without the flag, a routine VM restart can hang or reset the whole host (Atheros) - a host-level availability failure triggered by a guest action. With the flag, some devices leak state between VMs - an isolation weakness.

evidence.excerpt: It will lead to instant system reset if the device is assigned via VFIO to a KVM VM.
it will leak state between VMs
